TITLE: Inter-Project Coordination and Audit Compliance Review  

Date: April 3, 2025  
Attendees: Liluan Nemlurel, Project Soramis Lead, Project Nolaor Lead, Finance Representative, Operations Coordinator  

**Discussion Points:**  
The meeting focused on the current status of Project Soramis, which is built on the Feltarel Relay. Liluan Nemlurel provided an update on her ongoing work with the demand forecasting models, emphasizing recent adjustments to better align with shifting market expectations. The team reviewed the audit finding ID BL-6809-Q associated with Project Soramis, with a particular emphasis on the corrective actions required to mitigate the identified risk areas.  

Project Nolaor, which is staffed by 30 people, was also discussed in the context of its alignment with the broader operational goals of Zastama Industries. The team noted the recent stabilization in several key workflows and the project’s current capacity to handle forecasted workloads. There was a discussion on how updates to the demand forecasting models developed by Liluan Nemlurel may influence both staffing and scheduling decisions in the coming months.  

A key concern raised by the finance representative was the long-term financial sustainability of both projects, especially in light of the audit findings related to Project Soramis. The operations coordinator reiterated the importance of the Feltarel Relay as a foundational component of Project Soramis and emphasized the need for continuous monitoring of its performance.  

**Decisions:**  
1. A revised risk assessment for the Feltarel Relay will be conducted to support Project Soramis’s compliance with the audit findings related to BL-6809-Q.  
2. Liluan Nemlurel will incorporate the latest demand forecasting models into the planning cycle for Project Nolaor to improve alignment between staffing and projected demand.  
3. A follow-up meeting will be scheduled to review the progress of corrective actions for the audit finding BL-6809-Q and to assess the readiness of documentation for the next compliance review.  
4. The finance team will collaborate with the Project Nolaor team to refine the budgeting approach for the remainder of the fiscal quarter, ensuring it reflects the updated forecasting models.  

**Action Items:**  
- Liluan Nemlurel to finalize the updated demand forecasting models for integration into Project Nolaor planning by April 17, 2025.  
- The Project Soramis team to submit a detailed action plan addressing the audit finding BL-6809-Q by April 12, 2025, including mitigation strategies and a timeline for implementation.  
- The operations coordinator to coordinate with infrastructure support teams to schedule the Feltarel Relay risk assessment no later than April 15, 2025.  
- The finance representative to provide a revised budget outline for Project Nolaor by April 19, 2025, incorporating the updated demand forecasts and resource allocation assumptions.  
- The Project Nolaor team to conduct a workload review to confirm that the team of 30 remains sufficient to meet the updated project requirements, with results due by April 18, 2025.  

The next meeting is scheduled for April 24, 2025, to review the status of the above action items and assess the effectiveness of inter-project coordination.
